subject: [PATCH 15/22] mm/oom_kill: compare OOM constraints against common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the OOM (Out of Memory) killer's behavior to compare policy and cpuset constraints against common memory, rather than all memory. This change ensures that nodes outside the common memory zone do not artificially inflate the constrained capacity or make global policies appear constrained. The modification is made in the mm/oom_kill.c file and does not affect behavior when all memory is considered common.
